# Colorshot

> Colorshot (`@orshot/colorshot`) is an open source color and gradient picker for React and Vue, with a framework-free core. It takes and returns plain CSS strings: solid colors in any CSS format, and linear, radial, conic and repeating gradients. MIT licensed, made by Orshot.

- Docs and live demos: https://orshot.com/open-source/colorshot
- Source: https://github.com/rishimohan/colorshot
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@orshot/colorshot

## Install

```bash
npm i @orshot/colorshot
```

Import the stylesheet once, in the app's root layout or entry file:

```ts
import "@orshot/colorshot/styles.css";
```

## Entries

| Import | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `@orshot/colorshot/react` | React components: `ColorPicker`, `ColorField`, and composable `Picker.*` parts |
| `@orshot/colorshot/vue` | The same components for Vue 3 |
| `@orshot/colorshot` | Framework-free helpers: parsing, formatting, conversion, gradients, contrast, the picker store. Safe in server code |
| `@orshot/colorshot/styles.css` | The stylesheet. CSS resets cannot restyle the picker; theme variables in `@layer colorshot` lose to app CSS |

React 18/19 and Vue 3.5+ are optional peer dependencies. An app only bundles the entry it imports.

## React

```tsx
"use client"; // Next.js app router: the picker is a client component

import { useState } from "react";
import { ColorPicker } from "@orshot/colorshot/react";
import "@orshot/colorshot/styles.css";

export function FillPicker() {
  const [fill, setFill] = useState("linear-gradient(135deg, #3E5CEB 0%, #22C55E 100%)");
  return (
    <ColorPicker
      value={fill}
      onChange={setFill} // every frame while dragging or typing
      onChangeComplete={(value) => save(value)} // once, when the change is done
    />
  );
}
```

A field that opens the picker in a popover (flips to stay on screen, closes on Escape or outside click, returns focus). Takes every `ColorPicker` prop:

```tsx
import { ColorField } from "@orshot/colorshot/react";

<ColorField label="Fill" value={fill} onChange={setFill} gradientPresets />;
```

## Vue

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
import { ColorPicker } from "@orshot/colorshot/vue";
import "@orshot/colorshot/styles.css";

const fill = ref("#3E5CEB");
</script>

<template>
  <ColorPicker v-model="fill" @change-complete="save" />
</template>
```

## No framework

```ts
import { createPicker, parseColor, formatColor } from "@orshot/colorshot";

const picker = createPicker({ value: "#3E5CEB", onChange: (value) => console.log(value) });
picker.setHsva({ h: 140 });
picker.commit();

formatColor(parseColor("rgb(62 92 235 / 50%)").color, "hex"); // "#3e5ceb80"
```

## Common props (ColorPicker and ColorField)

- `value: string`: any CSS color or gradient. Text it cannot read is shown as unsupported and left unchanged. It never throws.
- `onChange(value)`: fires while dragging or typing, at most once per frame.
- `onChangeComplete(value)`: fires once when a change ends. Save and record undo here.
- `modes`: any of `"solid" | "linear" | "radial" | "conic"`. Default: all four. Use `modes={["solid"]}` where gradients are not allowed.
- `alpha: boolean`: show the opacity slider and field. Default `true`. Use `alpha={false}` where transparency is not allowed.
- `outputFormat: string | (color) => string`: how picked colors are written. Default keeps the format of the incoming value.
- `formats`: formats in the input menu, for example `["hex", "rgb", "hsl"]`.
- `swatches`: swatch groups, e.g. `[{ id: "brand", label: "Brand", colors: [{ value: "#3E5CEB", label: "Tide" }], onAdd, onRemove }, { id: "recent", label: "Recent", recent: true }]`. Groups also take `limit`, `showIn`, `onReorder`, `onRename`.
- `swatchSearch`: search every group by name, value or hex.
- `gradientPresets: boolean | string[]`: gradient swatches in gradient modes.
- `theme: "light" | "dark"`: force a theme. Default follows the OS.
- `size: "sm"`: compact, 240px wide.
- `variant: "inset"`: mode tabs first and a framed area.
- `storageKey: string | null`: where recent colors and the chosen format are remembered. `null` keeps them in memory.
- Optional features, all off by default: `space="oklch"`, `history` (undo/redo), `contrastWith="#fff"` (WCAG badge), `compare`, `tabIcons`, `swatchLayout="stack"`, `shortcuts={false}`, `eyeDropper={fn}`.

Always on: Cmd/Ctrl+C copies and Cmd/Ctrl+V pastes any CSS color or gradient while the picker has focus; keys 1-4 switch modes; two-finger trackpad swipes move the area, sliders, stops and angle; Alt-drag duplicates a stop; drag a stop off the bar or press Delete to remove it.

## Composable parts

Build your own layout from `Picker.Root` and its parts: `Area`, `Hue`, `Alpha`, `ModeTabs`, `GradientEditor`, `GradientBar`, `GradientControls`, `AngleDial`, `CenterPad`, `Inputs`, `EyeDropper`, `Swatches`, `Preview`, `Contrast`, `CurrentSwatch`, `Notice`.

```tsx
import { Picker } from "@orshot/colorshot/react";

<Picker.Root value={value} onChange={setValue} modes={["solid"]}>
  <Picker.Area />
  <Picker.Hue />
  <Picker.Inputs formats={["hex"]} alpha={false} />
</Picker.Root>;
```

## Core helpers (`@orshot/colorshot`)

- Colors: `parseColor`, `formatColor`, `convert`, `toSrgb`, `inGamut`, `toGamut`, `hsvToRgb`, `rgbToHsv`, `colorKey`
- Gradients: `isGradient`, `parseGradient`, `serializeGradient`, `gradientAngle`, `gradientCenter`
- Canvas handles: `gradientHandles(value, width, height)` returns handles for drawing a gradient editor on your own canvas (or `null` when the value is not a gradient); `moveGradientHandle(value, id, x, y, width, height, { snap })` returns the new CSS value
- Contrast: `contrastRatio`, `contrastLevel`, `luminance`
- Safety: `isSafeCssValue`, `safeCssValue`
- Store: `createPicker(options)`, the state machine the React and Vue pickers use

## Theming

Set CSS variables on the picker (`style`, `className` or a `[data-colorshot]` rule, not a parent): `--cs-accent`, `--cs-radius`, `--cs-width`, `--cs-shadow` and more. The variables sit in `@layer colorshot`, so unlayered app CSS overrides them without `!important`. Every other rule is unlayered and scoped to `[data-colorshot]`, so resets such as Tailwind preflight cannot restyle the picker in any load order. To restyle a part, match Colorshot's selector (`[data-colorshot] [data-part="swatch"]`) and load your CSS after Colorshot's.

## Notes for coding agents

- Keep the stored value format the user already has. Use `outputFormat` to match it (for example uppercase hex when opaque, `rgba()` otherwise).
- Save in `onChangeComplete`, not `onChange`.
- In Next.js, render the picker from a client component.
- With shadcn/ui, put `ColorField` (or `ColorPicker` inside your own Popover) where a color `Input` was, and map the theme: `[data-colorshot], [data-colorshot-field] { --cs-accent: var(--primary); --cs-bg: var(--popover); --cs-fg: var(--popover-foreground); --cs-border: var(--border); --cs-radius: var(--radius); }` (on shadcn/ui v3 wrap the tokens in `hsl()`).
- Agent skill: `npx skills add rishimohan/colorshot` installs `skills/colorshot/SKILL.md`.
